source.base_task:
I'm looking into large-scale English visual question answering datasets hosted on HuggingFace, particularly those released by academic institutions in the US.

Please find two English visual question answering datasets with more than 1M rows and provided with Croissant metadata, released by a research group from US universities with their HuggingFace profile explicitly stating the university affiliation. For each dataset, show me the link to the dataset on HuggingFace and a link to the HuggingFace profile of the organization.

i0.content: Find English visual question answering datasets on HuggingFace.

revisions.content: Only keep datasets with more than 1 million rows.
They should also provide Croissant metadata.

Identify two of them released by a research group from a US university, with the university affiliation stated on that group's HuggingFace profile. For each, give the dataset page link and the organization profile link.

milestones.semantic_concept: The HuggingFace search for English visual question answering datasets is established.
The English visual question answering search is being carried out under the more-than-1-million-rows criterion.
The English visual question answering search is being carried out with Croissant metadata required.

constraints.description: Datasets must be hosted on HuggingFace
Datasets must be English
Datasets must be visual question answering datasets
Each dataset must have more than 1 million rows
Each dataset must be provided with Croissant metadata
The final answer must identify two matching datasets
Each dataset must be released by a research group from a US university
The HuggingFace profile of the research group must explicitly state the university affiliation
For each dataset, the final answer must include the HuggingFace dataset page link and the organization profile link
